title: How to Make Hard Things Easier with Kahran & Divya
summary: Kahran and Divya think through how to make a hard thing easier on yourself — knowing when an idea is at the 10% vs 30% mark before you start, transposing a foreign-feeling task into a skill you already have, and recognizing when something just is hard and there's no shortcut. Detours into Leica glass, structured vs unstructured learning, and Kahran's Kathak training.
topics: when to start a new idea
knowing when something is just hard
